scorecards.inningsCommentary: Sri Lanka commenced their first innings at Vidarbha Cricket Association Stadium, aiming to set an imposing baseline total. The centerpiece of the innings was a brilliant 57 from LD Chandimal, complemented by a commanding 62-run stand between FDM Karunaratne and LD Chandimal that absorbed bowling hostility and accelerated the scoring rate to 2.58 RPO. India's bowling response was spearheaded by R Ashwin (4/67), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Folded for 205/10 (79.1 ov), Sri Lanka suffered an early setback, conceding vital first-innings momentum to India.

scorecards.inningsCommentary: India began their reply under scoreboard pressure, tasked with responding to Sri Lanka's opening innings total. The centerpiece of the innings was a brilliant 213 from Virat Kohli, complemented by a commanding 209-run stand between Cheteshwar Pujara and M Vijay that absorbed bowling hostility and accelerated the scoring rate to 3.46 RPO. Sri Lanka's bowling response was spearheaded by MDK Perera (3/202), who generated sustained pressure and triggered critical breakthroughs to prevent runaway scoring. Reaching 610/6 (176.1 ov), India's innings completed the first-innings exchange (405 Runs (India)), shaping the strategic contours for the second half of the Test.

summaryTab.matchCommentary:
The Test match at Vidarbha Cricket Association Stadium commenced with high tactical intensity as Sri Lanka posted 205/10 (79.1 ov) in their opening innings. In response, India countered with 610/6 (176.1 ov), setting the stage for a compelling contest of tactical endurance. Early sessions tested batting resolve against disciplined seam movement, with both attacks striving to gain the upper hand on a developing surface.

The defining turning point arrived during Century: Virat Kohli 213 (267b), which irrevocably altered the trajectory of the match. As the match progressed through its pivotal middle stages, Virat Kohli delivered a masterclass for India (213 Runs), absorbing intense pressure and tilting the momentum decisively. Crucial partnership stands and incisive bowling spells broke the opposition's resistance, shifting the control share (India 81%) and allowing India to dictate terms heading into the decisive sessions.

Entering the final innings, Sri Lanka faced an uphill battle under unrelenting scoreboard pressure. India's bowling unit, bolstered by R Ashwin (5 Runs & 8 Wkts), maintained relentless discipline and attacked the stumps relentlessly. Wicket clusters in the closing sessions dismantled any remaining resistance, sealing India won by innings & 239 runs in comprehensive fashion.

Verdict: India's triumph was built on superior pressure absorption, clinical execution during critical moments, and the ability to dominate key sessions. While Sri Lanka produced fighting phases, India won the pivotal turning points and sustained higher tactical control across all five days to emerge as deserved victors.
